name: Abbey and Altenmünster of Lorsch
description: Lorsch Abbey stands in a small Hessian town about 10 km east of Worms, where it was once among the most important monasteries of Charlemagne's empire. Little of the complex survives, but its 9th-century gatehouse, the Torhalle, still stands with patterned stonework and traces of early painting. Fragments of the abbey church and walls add to the picture.
